summary: Frontend-only verification of the new 'Kateqoriya baxışları' analytics card. Simulated an anonymous visitor navigating to 3 distinct category filter URLs (/products?category=SAAT, ?category=EYNƏK, ?category=ÜZÜK). trackCategoryView() incremented Firestore 'category_view_counts' docs (verified via localStorage throttle keys __dv_track_view_cat_saat, _eynək, _üzük). Then set localStorage.userRole=admin + userId, opened /admin, clicked 'Analitika' sidebar (password-protected, cleared using per-section password '2345' fetched via adminPasswordService.getAdminPasswords). On the Analytics overview tab, clicked 'Yenilə' to reload, then asserted the new card. All 5 acceptance-criteria data-testids resolve and display correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Firestore project 'devaleur-11742' returns 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED on the REST endpoint — the app still works via the SDK WebChannel, but this quota pressure is worth monitoring (unrelated to this feature).

trackCategoryView() writes with the raw category name as the doc field 'category' but slugifies for the doc id. This is fine, but note that per-category throttle keys use the lowercased slug (e.g. 'üzük'), so switching casing/spelling of the same category chip would create duplicate counters — not a bug for the current requirement but worth documenting.
The category-views card total displays 'Cəmi X baxış · N kateqoriya' — good info density; consider adding a 'lastViewed' timestamp per row for admin insight (already stored in Firestore).
test_credentials: Analytics section per-section password = '2345' (fetched from Firestore site_content/admin_passwords.perSection.analytics.password). Admin gate via localStorage: userRole=admin, userId=test-admin.
seed_data_creation: Incremented Firestore 'category_view_counts' docs for slugs: saat, eynək, üzük (2 views each after the two test runs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Analytics tab is password-protected. To open programmatically: click 'Analitika' sidebar entry, then fill input[type=password] with '2345' and click 'Daxil ol' (button). To fetch/verify admin passwords in-browser: `await (await import('/src/services/adminPasswordService.ts')).getAdminPasswords()`. Category chip data-testids on /products are `filter-category-<UPPERCASE_NAME>` (e.g. filter-category-SAAT). URL param based navigation `/products?category=<name>` triggers trackCategoryView() via the searchParams effect in ProductsPage.tsx (~line 314). The 60s throttle is a per-slug localStorage key `__dv_track_view_cat_<slug>` — clear these before re-testing counter increments.

test_evidence.toggle-category-views: not rendered (only 3 categories, <=5 threshold — matches spec: 'appears if more than 5')
